keyQuotes.quote: Keyboarding limited to no more than 2 hours per day, in intervals of 20 minutes or less.
I am requesting the following temporary changes: 1. Dictation software for file notes and emails. 2. An ergonomic split keyboard. 3. Reassignment of the daily scanning batch.

Continuous data entry is an essential function of the Escrow Assistant role as written, and we are not in a position to remove the scanning batch from the role or to fund special equipment at this time.
Data entry of file information into the escrow production system (approximately 5-6 hours per day).
